# Aqua Heroes Swim School

> Aqua Heroes Swim School is a swim school founded in 2017 that teaches babies from 3 months, children and adults in Essex. Lessons follow the Swim England Learn to Swim Pathway (Ducklings, then stages 1 to 10). Contact: info@aquaheroes.co.uk, WhatsApp 07459 182508.

## Key facts
- Ages: from 3 months old to adults.
- Lesson types: group lessons, private 1:1 and 1:2 lessons (including SEN), baby and pre-school lessons, adult lessons, and holiday crash courses.
- Group lessons: 25 minutes, with 3 to 4 beginners per teacher (5 to 6 learners from stage 5). From £12.50 per lesson.
- Private lessons: 1:1 from £35 and 1:2 from £40 per 25 minute lesson. Pay as you go is £40 and £45.
- Trial: free for group lessons if you book a 9 week term (T&Cs apply).
- Pools with regular lessons: Hornchurch, Brentwood, Basildon, Billericay and Loughton. Waiting lists: Romford and Ilford.
- Awards: termly recognition with official Swim England certificates and badges, plus online progress tracking.
- Booking: register on https://www.aquaheroes.co.uk/book-a-lesson and Aqua Heroes confirms availability and arranges a trial lesson.

## Lessons and pools
- [Swimming Lessons in Essex](https://www.aquaheroes.co.uk/): Swimming lessons in Essex for babies from 3 months, children and adults. Group and private lessons in Hornchurch, Brentwood, Basildon, Billericay and Loughton.
- [Swimming Lessons for All Ages](https://www.aquaheroes.co.uk/swimming-lessons): Group lessons, private 1:1 and 1:2, baby and pre-school, adult lessons and holiday crash courses across Essex. See prices, class sizes and how to book.
- [Children's Swimming Lessons in Essex](https://www.aquaheroes.co.uk/childrens-swimming-lessons): Small-group swimming lessons for children aged 3 and up in Hornchurch, Brentwood, Basildon, Billericay and Loughton. Swim England pathway, from £12.50 a lesson.
- [Baby and Pre-School Swimming Lessons](https://www.aquaheroes.co.uk/baby-swimming-lessons): Swimming lessons from 3 months old, including parent and baby and pre-school sessions in Billericay and Romford, with our sister school Little Legends.
- [Adult Swimming Lessons in Essex](https://www.aquaheroes.co.uk/adult-swimming-lessons): Adult swimming lessons for complete beginners and improvers, in Hornchurch on Thursday evenings and Billericay by day. Group and private 1:1 lessons.
- [Private Swimming Lessons, 1:1 and 1:2](https://www.aquaheroes.co.uk/private-swimming-lessons): Private 1:1 and 1:2 swimming lessons in Essex, including SEN lessons. From £35 for 1:1 and £40 for 1:2, at our pools or your own indoor pool.
- [Swimming Pool Locations in Essex](https://www.aquaheroes.co.uk/swimming-lessons-essex): Find Aqua Heroes swimming lessons in Hornchurch, Brentwood, Basildon, Billericay and Loughton, plus waiting lists for Romford and Ilford. Days, times and venues.

## Pool pages
- [Swimming Lessons in Hornchurch](https://www.aquaheroes.co.uk/swimming-lessons-hornchurch): Swimming lessons in Hornchurch at The Campion School: children on Saturdays and Sundays, adults and 1:1 on Thursday evenings. Small classes, from £12.50.
- [Swimming Lessons in Brentwood](https://www.aquaheroes.co.uk/swimming-lessons-brentwood): Swimming lessons in Brentwood at St Helens Junior School on Wednesdays, 4.15 to 6.45 pm, for children aged 3 and up. Small classes taught by Aqua Heroes.
- [Swimming Lessons in Basildon](https://www.aquaheroes.co.uk/swimming-lessons-basildon): Swimming lessons in Basildon at James Hornsby School on Monday and Wednesday evenings and Sunday afternoons, for children aged 3 and up.
- [Swimming Lessons in Billericay](https://www.aquaheroes.co.uk/swimming-lessons-billericay): Swimming lessons in Billericay at Quilters Junior School: parent and baby, pre-school, SEN and adult lessons by day, and child groups on Fridays.
- [Swimming Lessons in Loughton](https://www.aquaheroes.co.uk/swimming-lessons-loughton): Swimming lessons in Loughton at Davenant Foundation School on Thursday evenings, 7.15 to 9.15 pm, for children aged 3 and up.
- [Swimming Lessons in Romford](https://www.aquaheroes.co.uk/swimming-lessons-romford): Swimming lessons in Romford for parent and baby, pre-school and SEN learners. The pool is closed for refurbishment, so join our waiting list.
- [Swimming Lessons in Ilford](https://www.aquaheroes.co.uk/swimming-lessons-ilford): Swimming lessons in Ilford at Caterham High School. The pool is closed for refurbishment, so join the Aqua Heroes waiting list for when lessons restart.

- [Swimming Teacher Jobs in Essex](https://www.aquaheroes.co.uk/opportunities): Swimming teacher jobs in Essex with Aqua Heroes. Supportive team, onboarding, flexible weekly hours and great rates of pay. Level 1 or 2 and NPLQ needed.
- [Swimming Lesson FAQs: Prices, Times, Ages](https://www.aquaheroes.co.uk/faqs): Answers about Aqua Heroes swimming lessons: prices from £12.50, class sizes, ages from 3 months, pool locations and times, trial lessons and how to book.
- [Contact Aqua Heroes Swim School](https://www.aquaheroes.co.uk/contactus): Contact Aqua Heroes Swim School about swimming lessons, prices and availability. Message us by form, email or WhatsApp and we aim to reply within 24 hours.
